title: Canonical constructible compact-support projection mates
statement: Fix a finite-field coefficient datum and its six-functor operation datum [def-fix-six-functor-datum]. For a separated finite-type morphism $f:X\to Y$ and a compactification $f=pj$ [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed], use the identity base-change square retaining that compactification. The compact-support projection component is the recorded proper counit mate followed by the inverse open projection and the canonical pullback composition [def-exchange-projection]. Its source is $f_!K\otimes L$ and its target $f_!(K\otimes f^*L)$. At positive finite coefficient level, take arbitrary bounded constructible $K$ and finite-Tor bounded constructible $L$ [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. Restrict the existing tensor and pullback [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] to these domains. Define the finite constructible component by the published fixed-coefficient proper/open projection, conjugated by the specified coefficient realization, tensor, support and K-flat/exact pullback comparisons, and lifted through the full constructible inclusion. Define its proper specialization by the actual proper identification and its pullback compositor by the full inclusion. Define projection coherence to mean invertibility of these precise components, naturality in both variables, compactification independence, the support/pullback composition equation, compositor associativity, and agreement with the actual proper counit mate [thm-sf-comp-composition]. This definition of coherence assumes none of its laws; those are the projection-formula theorem. It imposes no finite-Tor restriction on $K$ and no separatedness on the structure morphisms of $X,Y$.
